Only those who heard the sound of heavy rain in the grass built houses knows the beauty of rain sounds and the beauty of nature’s sense,anything else have metallic sound and synthetic sense.
I lived in all and I can tell y’all that the nature is poison,you don’t even have to study it to know the difference,you just have to live it like I do.
I grew being called poor,I never for once thought I was poor,I grew up well,healthy and happy,left the “POVERTY “came to the most world con-vet and I immediately felt the difference,I knew that this world isn’t my home,it’s not welcoming at all, and most importantly it looks lavish but poisonous ,everything is synthetic including what I grew up knowing that God is the only provider of it”weather “
I have seen something that looks like hailstones but on the clearer look it’s poisonous,never smell sand because here they don’t want it either,so it covered with synthetic chemicals and green looking grass
The place looks gloriously beautiful but people living in it are dying daily being poisoned by the same thing that provides the look,it’s so expensive that lives pays for it and everyone it still glorifies it,they stand high and bully the Nature,however it’s scrambling unnoticeable.
I wish we would go back to Nature,I wanna smell it ,feel,hear it and be healed once again.



Not religious.
Not a poem but the organic feeling from me and the information to pass to y’all 
I’m also as young as many of y’all who just happened to be blessed to have lived life in many expect with different life experiences from different worlds .
